afterFix.note: Round 2 (2026-10-18): new level set (sha below), extra levels across chapters 3-5 and 8-10. Clumsy ran 8 levels and casual 14 (later levels are far past where they fail). Bot changes: remembers a push that froze a crate, restarts when every push is losing, cancels a crate it selected by mis-tap, skilled plans with a 3000-node search before falling back to 2-push lookahead. Measured before the short-flick change, so casual/clumsy dropped swipes are an upper bound.

method: push-space bots acting only through touch: tap a floor cell to walk, D-pad tap or board swipe to push, 復原/重來 buttons; caps per attempt 4 x optimal pushes + 20 actions and 120 s + 6 s x pushes
beforeNote: before-run stopped after ~60 min wall time (machine load average 20-27); clumsy L99/L100 not run; rapid-input probe not run (done after fix)

findings.title: D-pad auto-repeat adds a step when the release arrives late
findings.detail: Holding a D-pad key repeated after 320-380 ms; when touchEnd was delayed (slow device / heavy load) one tap moved two cells. doubleCounted pushes: skilled 13, casual 12, clumsy 6, world 5, superhuman 1 (superhuman uses exact 16 ms taps).
findings.repro: Tap a D-pad key with a delayed touchEnd (CDP under load): moves +2.

findings.title: Par (標準) far too loose on late levels
findings.detail: Stored solutions came from a push-space greedy solver and wasted walking: L56 par 135 (50 possible), L100 par 424 (253 possible). World bot got 3 stars on L100 with 340 moves; stars meant little after chapter 3.

findings.title: Tap-to-walk misses on large rooms
findings.detail: On 11-12 wide rooms cells are ~30 px; taps landing on a wall next to the intended floor cell did nothing. Missed walks: casual 877/1290, skilled 109/515, clumsy 587/668.
findings.repro: Level 75 at 390x844: tap the edge of a floor cell next to a wall.

findings.title: Swipe hold-repeat timing-dependent
findings.detail: A swipe held >300 ms repeated the step (seen under load in demo/verify.js: one swipe = 2 moves).
findings.repro: Swipe and keep the finger down 1 s.

findings.title: Curve is smooth, no wall
findings.detail: clumsy L1-L10, casual L1-L25, skilled L1-L75 (L75 on 2nd try), world and superhuman 7/7. 0 page/console errors in ~2,900 real touch actions.
